shot_details.title: Village morning opens
shot_details.action: Warm sunlight spills over a small ancient village. Clay homes. Woven baskets. Goats nosing through straw. A baker pulls flatbread from a clay oven. Children dart between adults carrying water jars and bundles of reeds.

shot_details.title: Miri and Nim run the lane
shot_details.action: MIRI runs through the lane with NIM at her heels. Nim bounds lightly, oversized ears bouncing, nose twitching.

shot_details.title: The hidden bundle
shot_details.action: Miri clutches a small cloth bundle close to her chest.

dialogue.line: Is it bread pretending not to be bread?

audio.ambience: warm morning village ambience; distant goats, children, foot traffic, clay oven crackle; no music
sfx: quick child footsteps on packed earth

shot_details.title: Miri reveals the cakes
shot_details.continuity: Miri still clutches the small cloth bundle; Nim remains at her heels.
shot_details.action: MIRI stops beside a low wall and peeks inside the bundle. Three small HONEY-DATE CAKES gleam in the cloth.

shot_details.title: Nim beholds treasure
shot_details.action: Nim gasps as though beholding treasure.

dialogue.line: Ima made them for after chores.

shot_details.title: The perfect arrangement
shot_details.continuity: The cloth bundle remains open with three small HONEY-DATE CAKES inside.

dialogue.line: A perfect arrangement. Let no one disturb it.

audio.ambience: morning village ambience nearby; soft goats and distant children; no music
sfx: small feet stopping beside low wall
soft sticky glint of cakes implied by close handling

constraints: When the bundle is open, exactly three small HONEY-DATE CAKES are visible.

shot_details.title: Ima appears with linen
shot_details.continuity: Miri still has the cloth bundle with the honey-date cakes; Nim remains beside her.
shot_details.action: Miri smiles and folds the cloth shut just as IMA appears from the doorway with a basket of folded linen.

shot_details.title: The errand begins
shot_details.continuity: Ima holds the basket of folded linen; Miri holds the closed cloth bundle.

dialogue.line: Miri, take these to Saba Elior, please. His old sleeves are more patch than sleeve.

audio.ambience: quiet morning village courtyard ambience; no music

constraints: The basket contains folded linen, not food.

shot_details.title: Ima adds Tav
shot_details.continuity: Ima holds the basket of folded linen; Miri holds the closed cloth bundle; Nim remains beside Miri.

dialogue.line: Again. And if you pass Tav on the way, give him one of the honey cakes.

shot_details.title: Miri and Nim freeze
shot_details.continuity: The closed cloth bundle stays against Miri; the linen basket remains with Ima.
shot_details.action:
Miri freezes.
Nim freezes too. He slowly turns toward Miri, eyes wide.

dialogue.line: Perhaps there are two Tavs. We should confirm before making decisions.

audio.ambience: morning courtyard ambience with distant village life; no music
sfx: small silence beat in the courtyard
Nim's light turn on packed earth

shot_details.title: Yesterday and today
shot_details.continuity: Miri and Nim remain frozen; Ima remains by the doorway with the linen basket.

dialogue.line: Ima, Tav had a cake yesterday.

shot_details.title: Miri counts the loss
shot_details.continuity: Miri still holds the closed cloth bundle containing three honey-date cakes.
shot_details.action: MIRI looks down at the cloth bundle.

dialogue.line: But if I give one away, I will only have two.
That is usually how giving works.

audio.ambience: soft morning courtyard ambience; distant animals and villagers; no music

constraints: The honey-date cakes remain inside the closed cloth bundle; no cake is removed.

shot_details.title: Saving one for later
shot_details.continuity: Miri looks down at the cloth bundle; Ima stays near her with the linen basket.

dialogue.line: But I was going to save one for later.

shot_details.title: Open hands
shot_details.continuity: Miri still holds the closed cloth bundle; the linen basket remains present.
shot_details.action: IMA kneels, warm but firm.

dialogue.line: Small hands can still be open hands.
But what if there is not enough?

audio.ambience: gentle morning courtyard ambience; no music

constraints: Ima kneels without taking the cloth bundle from Miri.

shot_details.title: Ima offers Saba's story
shot_details.continuity: Ima is kneeling near Miri; Miri holds the closed cloth bundle; Nim stays beside Miri.
shot_details.action: Ima studies her. She does not force it.

dialogue.line: Then ask Saba what he thinks. He always has a story tucked somewhere.

shot_details.title: Miri's answer
shot_details.continuity: Miri keeps the cloth bundle close.
shot_details.action: Miri exhales, not satisfied.

dialogue.line: Stories do not fill empty stomachs.

shot_details.title: Nim agrees
shot_details.continuity: Nim remains beside Miri.
shot_details.action: Nim pats his own belly with grave agreement.

audio.ambience: quiet morning courtyard ambience with distant village life; no music

shot_details.title: The basket is handed over
shot_details.continuity: Miri holds the closed cloth bundle; Ima is beside her; Nim remains nearby.
shot_details.action: Ima hands Miri the linen basket. Miri tucks the honey cakes deeper inside the cloth.

audio.ambience: morning courtyard ambience; distant goats, villagers, and children; no music

constraints: The honey-date cakes remain hidden inside the cloth after Miri tucks them deeper.

3.heading: EXT. SABA ELIOR’S COURTYARD — LATE MORNING

shot_details.title: Saba's sparrow tale beneath the fig tree
shot_details.action: SABA ELIOR sits beneath a fig tree, surrounded by several village children. He is repairing a sandal with one hand and gesturing grandly with the other.

dialogue.line: And so the little sparrow said to the great camel, “If your knees bend, perhaps your pride may also.”
